Impact: north-star leg A — every agent that trusts the advertised discovery card fails to reach the live MCP server (live-probed: card says `sse` at `/api/mcp` → 404; real server is Streamable HTTP at `/mcp` → serving)

# PR explainer: 265 — MCP discovery cards fixed

## Goal
Agents that follow `www.defi.garden`'s published MCP discovery card (sent on
**every response** via `vercel.json`'s `Link` header) must land on a working
endpoint with a truthful transport and capability set — not a 404.

## Intuition
Item 228 shipped a real MCP server at `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP, tools-only).
228's own verifier then discovered the site's `.well-known/` discovery
cards — which predate 228 — had always pointed at a *different*, non-existent
path (`/api/mcp`), claimed a transport the server doesn't use (`sse`), and
advertised a capability the server doesn't implement (`prompts`). That bug
was harmless while the Worker wasn't deployed. The human deployed it
2026-08-12, so the mismatch went from "wrong on paper" to "actively
misdirecting live agent traffic" — this item closes that gap.

## What changed, in reading order
1. **`.well-known/mcp.json`, `.well-known/mcp/server-card.json`,
   `.well-known/mcp/server-cards.json`** — all three (kept byte-identical)
   now declare `url: https://www.defi.garden/mcp`, `type: streamable-http`,
   and `capabilities: { tools: { list, call } }` only (dropped `prompts`).
2. **`validate_readiness.py:62`** — readiness probe now hits `/mcp`, not the
   dead `/api/mcp`.
3. **`dns-aid-zone.txt:14`** — the DNS-AID template's MCP path now `/mcp`.
4. **`SKILL.md:74`** — the generic serverless-handler example now says
   `/mcp`.
5. **`edge/MCP.md`** — the "discovery cards are WRONG" section rewritten to
   state they're fixed (an agent-facing living doc, not a dated log — it
   would itself become a false claim if left stale).
6. **`test_mcp_discovery_cards.js`** (new, registered in
   `package.json`'s `test:serial`) — glob-enumerates every `.well-known/**`
   file with "mcp" in its path (never a hand-typed 3-file list), asserts
   each card's url/transport/capabilities against `edge/mcp-core.js`'s own
   `SERVER_CAPABILITIES` export (set-equality, both directions — a card and
   the server can't silently drift apart again), and asserts the 3 residue
   files no longer mention `/api/mcp`.

## Deviations from spec
See `specs/265-notes.md` — the `type` string choice (`streamable-http` vs
bare `http`) and the `edge/MCP.md` rewrite are both recorded there.

## Not in scope (unchanged)
`openapi.json` path drift (262, BLOCKED on the human), free/paid boundary
prose drift (267, unbuilt), registry listings (human-owned).
